messages:
devrel-bot: Post-all-hands follow-up — drop quick clarifying Qs about roadmap, mission, and competitors.
jamie_ceo: Will keep answers short here; we'll publish a one-pager after.
rory_product: Roadmap prioritization: do we shift more R&D to latency/cost improvements for mid-market use-cases or keep heavy infra work for enterprise SLAs?
jamie_ceo: Balance. Short term: accelerate low-hanging ops optimizations that improve cost for all customers. Parallel path: dedicate a small squad to enterprise SLA/rollout features.
lina_growth: For GTM: should we segment messaging by company size or by use-case (compliance vs scale vs dev experience)? Which maps better to product tiers?
maya_sales: Use-case-first. Devs care about friction (Hosted), infra teams care about SLAs (Dedicated), legal/compliance need Private. That maps cleanly to tiered offers.
chris_sre: Competitor question: some vendors pitch "all-in-one model + infra" as simpler. How do we rebut succinctly in technical conversations?
olivia_cto: Rebut with ops reality: bundling models doesn't guarantee consistent latency or cost at scale. Highlight our KV caching, smart routing, and verified perf profiles — those are operational differentiators.
rory_product: Can we get a short FAQ line for customers asking "why not just use hyperscaler X?"
jamie_ceo: Suggested line: "Hyperscalers give model access; Redwood gives predictable serving economics and operational controls across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments." Keep it factual.
lina_growth: Request: marketing needs 3 distinct one-liners for devs/infra/legal. Who owns?
maya_sales: Maya + Lina will draft; Olivia will provide 2 tech bullets per persona.
rory_product: Is publishing benchmarks public or gated? Some customers want reproducible results.
jamie_ceo: Publish a lightweight reproducible benchmark kit publicly for core models and seq lengths. Keep full internal suite gated.
chris_sre: SLA detail: what do we promise for Dedicated p99? Is it per-route or cluster-level?
olivia_cto: Per-route SLOs backed by dedicated capacity and autoscaling policies; we'll publish p50/p95/p99 examples for common configs.
maya_sales: On pricing: how aggressive are migration incentives from Hosted -> Dedicated? Credits or discounts?
jamie_ceo: Use migration credits + tiered commit discounts (roughly 15-30% depending on commit). Finance to finalize thresholds.
lina_growth: Action items: one-pager (Rory), messaging bullets (Lina/Maya), benchmark kit (Olivia), migration plan (Finance + Maya). Owners post drafts in this thread by EOD Thu.
jamie_ceo: Thanks all — keep follow-ups short here or book time. :rocket:
